items.q: The Trenniers at that time were probably just starting into 'Bama State College... That's just around the time that they went in.

ctx.x: So what I wondered was if it lasted was that the that long, (Inaudible) beginning and that's what I wanted to ask (Inaudible) you about.

The beginning was out here in California. The Trenniers at that time were probably just starting into 'Bama State College, where they went and worked with the 'Bama State Collegians in Montgomery, Alabama. That's just around the time that they went in.
